changes.title: Darling in the FRANXX - UI Theme (Anime Screencaps)

current.changeLog:
Garage widget repositioning. The hangar percentile bar can now be moved: Ctrl+drag it directly, or use the numeric X/Y steppers in settings, plus a Follow Carousel toggle. Includes a reset-to-default command.
Saved settings survive upgrades. This release migrates values across the bump, so your configuration is preserved (Aslain ModsSettingsAPI; fail-soft to a fresh install).

previous.changeLog:
- Re-packed with proper game folder
- Updated enhanced modsSettingsApi 1.6.4

current.changeLog: - Updated Object 279 Mission Auto Reset 1.0.2 (renamed from Personal Mission 2 Auto Reset, now strictly limited to Object 279 missions, and it will no longer discard the last mission you have selected there)

previous.changeLog:
New "Progress Mode" setting. Choose how the XP readout is shown: Current (just your accumulated XP) or Current / Required (your XP against what the next step needs), per bar mode. Configure it in the mod's settings panel.
New "Show Progress %" toggle. Optionally prepend the completion percentage (capped at 100%) to the left of the readout, so you can see at a glance how close the current step is.

current.changeLog: Your saved settings survive updates. Bar position, size, and toggles are now preserved when the mod updates its internal settings format, so a new version no longer resets your layout.
